mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing cycle, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by > 0.25% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 2% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above 600,000 units for three consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related earnings and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 1% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings for industrial firms and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals easing inflationary pressure, which reduces the likelihood of aggressive Fed tightening and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
